splash.tagline: Your bus, on time, every village

tickets.title: Single tickets
tickets.body: A single ticket is for one seat on one bus, from one stop to another, on the date shown. Show the live QR to the conductor when you board.

groups.title: Group tickets
groups.body: You can book up to 6 people together. Children under 12 pay half the adult fare. Enter the real age of each person: the conductor may ask for proof.

passes.title: Day, weekly, monthly and zone passes
passes.body: A pass gives unlimited trips while it is active, one scan per trip. A zone pass works only on village and ordinary buses inside the one district you picked.

children.title: Child cards
children.body: A parent can buy a pass for a child under 18. Each time the card is scanned on a bus, the parent gets a message with the route and time.

qr.title: Live QR codes
qr.body: The QR code changes every 3 seconds. Screenshots and forwarded codes stop working, so always open the live ticket in the app.

refunds.title: Cancellations and refunds
refunds.body: Refunds follow the policy shown before you cancel. The reservation fee is not refunded. Money returns to the way you paid.

conduct.title: On the bus
conduct.body: Carry a photo ID for free travel and concession passes. Follow the instructions of the conductor and keep the bus clean and safe.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.body: We keep your name, phone or email, tickets and trips to run the service. We never sell your data. Location is used only while you choose to share it.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You can sign in with an email or phone code, or with Google. Keep your phone safe. You can ask us to delete your account at any time.

classes.title: Bus types and one ticket for all buses
classes.body: Buses are Normal, Express or Super Luxury. A ticket works on its own class and on lower classes: Normal on Normal buses, Express on Express and Normal, Super Luxury on all three. On the same day you may board another bus that runs through both of your stops; your reserved seat stays on the bus you booked.

busTypes.title: Bus types and ticket rules
busTypes.description: Which buses your ticket works on, and how one ticket can take you on any bus of your class.

NORMAL.rule: Can travel only in Normal buses.
NORMAL.note: Best for short and local routes.

EXPRESS.rule: Can travel in Express and Normal buses.

SUPER_LUXURY.rule: Can travel in Super Luxury, Express and Normal buses.
SUPER_LUXURY.note: Most comfort and a premium experience.

oneTicket.title: One ticket for all buses
oneTicket.lead: Your ticket is for your stops and your date, not only for one bus.
oneTicket.how: If your bus is late or full, board any other bus that day of your class or a lower class that runs through both of your stops. Show the live QR to the conductor. Your reserved seat stays on the bus you booked, so on another bus you may have to stand.

benefits.usage: More use of Super Luxury and Express buses

shops.title: Shops near your stop
shops.body: Local shops and malls can show offers to riders who board close to them.

colleges.title: Admissions open?
colleges.body: Colleges and coaching centres can reach students on the screen they open on every trip.
